The founder of modern human anatomy is **Andreas Vesalius**.  
His father was **Anders van Wesel** (sometimes written Anders van Wesel / Andries van Wezel). He worked as an apothecary for the Habsburg emperors (Maximilian I and later Charles V) before his son became the renowned anatomist.
